insight: Founded in 2020 by Konstantina Psoma in her final year at university; raised a $15M Series A led by a16z Games in March 2024.
name: Kaedim
description: An AI 3D-asset production platform that converts 2D images and concept art into game-ready 3D models with clean topology. Pairs generative AI with a human-in-the-loop QA step so output meets production specs, custom art styles, and pipeline requirements. Used across games, e-commerce, product design, and AR/VR by studios including Aardman, Rebellion, and The Sandbox.
edge: Pairs generative 3D with a human QA review step to deliver clean, production-ready topology, not raw meshes — aimed squarely at game and product pipelines.
pros: Matches custom art styles and specs
Used by Aardman, Rebellion, The Sandbox

references.title: Kaedim Raises $15M in Series A Funding
